verified_behavior: Scenario23 completes each real three-person roster, branch-dependent following or courier marking/release, physical same-host signal pickup/mount, individual passenger boarding, all-owned-bodies-free checks and protected launch for both outcomes.

Scenario24 passes all twelve original recovery helpers, including actual sentry exposure/Holding retreat/fresh E, release/capture generation invalidation, signal custody/checkpoint and physical berth/gangway checks.
Checkpoint restoration occurs through actual scene reloads in the same process; durable roster/item state is tested without claiming persistent disk saves.

Physical movement uses the bounded acceptance walker, original targets/deadlines and collision/navigation/footing checks. Actual obstruction may cause a valid lateral sidestep; no radius or collision gates are relaxed.
fixture_scope: EnterFromFerry records the selected outcome and seeds prior riverside objective flags, then invokes the actual explicit Far Shore Continue button; it does not play the original14 or riverside missions.
StartAtRefuge directly places the free amoeba at refuge and grants the InnerRefuge prerequisite. M18 route traversal belongs to separate scenario21.
Unrelated island guards are parked at an authored test location and stunned for baseline traversal; the exposure helper spawns its own real visible guard. Calm clears unrelated suspicion.
Ordinary role hosts and controlled couriers are initially force-possessed by setup. Subsequent escort/courier/signal interactions use simulated E/Q and real controller/NavMesh movement.

Independent recovery fixtures seed specific delivered/mounted prerequisites and deliberately position bodies or people for negative custody/boarding/ownership checks. Branch extraction also positions inactive amoebae for negative gates. These prepared slices are not a continuous human playthrough.
